parts.html: The K-15 standard model is a modern kitchen with an island in a rich red. The cabinets are simply shaped, the fronts are painted in a solid color, and the countertop is porcelain stoneware.

Red stands out on its own, so the kitchen needs no extra decor. The surrounding walls are best kept neutral, and natural stone and wood go well with red. The cabinet shapes are simple, so a bright kitchen like this can go into an apartment as well as an open-plan house.
Layout — a straight run along the wall and a separate island. The run holds built-in appliances, work surfaces, and cabinets, and the island adds one more countertop.
The upper and lower fronts are painted the same red, and the stone-textured porcelain stoneware countertop tones it down.
Hinge type: Hettich with soft-close mechanism
You can order the K-15 to fit your kitchen — with a different-sized island, another cabinet configuration, or in a different color.
